mapper.select: /* apiDefReg.selDefListByApiSpcNo */ SELECT d.api_no AS "apiNo" ,c.ctgry_nm AS "ctgryNm" ,d.api_nm AS "apiNm" ,d.api_path AS "apiPath" ,d.method_cd AS "methodCd" FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF d LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_CTGRY c ON c.API_CTGRY_NO = d.API_CTGRY_NO WHERE d.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer ORDER BY c.SORT_ODRG, d.SORT_ODRG

/* apiDefReg.selApiDefDetail */ SELECT api_no AS "apiNo" ,api_spc_no AS "apiSpcNo" ,api_ctgry_no AS "apiCtgryNo" ,api_nm AS "apiNm" ,api_desc AS "apiDesc" ,api_path AS "apiPath" ,method_cd AS "methodCd" ,api_gubun AS "apiClass" ,api_handler_cd AS "apiHandlerCd" ,provider_seq AS "providerSeq" ,endpnt_tb_url AS "endpntTbUrl" ,endpnt_prd_url AS "endpntPrdUrl" ,endpnt_client_ip AS "endpntClientIp" ,endpnt_timeout AS "endpntTimeout" ,resmap_res_cd_field AS "resmapResCdField" ,resmap_succ_val AS "resmapSuccVal" ,resmap_err_cd_field AS "resmapErrCdField" ,resmap_err_msg_field AS "resmapErrMsgField" ,hdp_api_endpoint_id AS "hdpApiEndpointId" ,hdp_req_api_name AS "hdpReqApiName" ,hdp_api_out_format AS "hdpApiOutFormat" ,hdp_api_out_common_param AS "hdpApiOutCommonParam" ,hdp_req_mapping_to_body AS "hdpReqMappingToBody" ,hdp_res_mapping_to_body AS "hdpResMappingToBody" FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}::integer

/* apiDefReg.selParamListByApiNo */ SELECT param_no AS "paramNo" ,param_nm AS "paramNm" ,data_type_cd AS "dataTypeCd" ,required AS "required" ,param_desc AS "paramDesc" ,param_loc AS "paramLoc" ,param_type_cd AS "paramTypeCd" ,sort_odrg AS "sortOdrg" ,prnts_param_no AS "prntsParamNo" ,obj_no AS "objNo" ,obj_odrg AS "objOdrg" ,exam AS "exam" ,personal_data AS "personalData" FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}::integer ORDER BY SORT_ODRG, PARAM_NO

/* apiDefReg.selSpcByNo */ SELECT s.api_spc_no AS "apiSpcNo" ,s.api_nm AS "spcNm" ,s.sys_id AS "sysId" ,s.host AS "host" ,s.bas_path AS "basPath" ,s.ver AS "ver" FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC s WHERE s.DEL_YN = 'N' AND s.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer
/* apiDefReg.selDefaultCtgryBySpc */ SELECT API_CTGRY_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_CTGRY WHERE API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY API_CTGRY_NO LIMIT 1

/* apiDefReg.selTmpltList */ SELECT tmplt_no AS "tmpltNo" ,tmplt_nm AS "tmpltNm" ,COALESCE(tmplt_desc, '') AS "tmpltDesc" ,api_class AS "apiClass" ,mth_type_cd AS "mthTypeCd" ,COALESCE(path_pattern, '') AS "pathPattern" ,COALESCE(dflt_param_json, '') AS "dfltParamJson" ,sort_odrg AS "sortOdrg" FROM KOA_TB_API_QUICK_TMPLT WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ODRG, TMPLT_NO
mapper.delete: /* apiDefReg.delParamsByApiNo */ DELETE FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}::integer AND PARAM_TYPE_CD IN ('PRMTYP1010', 'PRMTYP1020')
